title: World Hunter Sorrento coordinate audit
policy: Coordinates are collectible targets only when the point is a verified safe public arrival point. Site-centre coordinates, broad areas, inaccessible internal features and unsafe final approaches are not collectible targets. Coordinate review is not a substitute for on-site safety checks.
